turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
help you shop
menu
For standard ground shipments (like FedEx Ground), the carrier assesses a $20.00 fee per package for rerouting in transit.
For freight shipments, a new quote is required for an address change.
Please note that if the new address is in a different state, state tax requirements will require canceling and reordering to the correct state.
If you would like to request an address update for your order, please submit a support ticket so our team can check eligibility and assist you.

Our goal is always to deliver the highest quality craftsmanship as safely and quickly as possible. If your order is experiencing an unusual delay, please let us know your order details so our support team can check on its status for you!
